# Third-party sources

- `superwriter/436149d87908a462b5f74270cb43d797163f6e17/` retains the pinned official [SuperWriter source](https://github.com/mozhu621/SuperWriter). Its provenance lists exact upstream URLs and SHA-256 values. The project executes only the audited pure `extract_sections` and `generate_prompt` functions. The archived source snapshot does not establish a blanket redistribution license; this repository remains private.
- `dramaturge/appendix_prompts.json` retains attributed [Dramaturge appendix prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.05188), used as writing-role references. Attribution does not imply reproduction of trained models or experiments.
- `strands-decider/` retains the original upstream model/head code. Its Apache-2.0 license is included and applies to that code. Model weights are not included.

Third-party code and literary data retain their own terms. This repository does not apply a new common license to those materials.
